hero.subtitle: Real-time monitoring and operations in one view of racks, assets, PDUs, the power chain and the environment — down to the port and the battery cell. European, air-gapped, graph-first.

capabilities.title: See everything, from the data hall floor down to the port and the cell.

cards.d: Accurate, real-time views of the whole site: servers, storage, network, rack PDUs, patch panels and applications. Map physical relationships down to the port.
A single database of connections and capacity. Space, weight, temperature, humidity, load, budgeted power and measured amps — no more floor walks.
Change requests, automated device moves and a full audit trail of work orders to keep operations efficient and compliant.
See how energy is consumed and where to save. Building meters, UPS, floor PDUs, busways and intelligent rack PDUs. Built-in ASHRAE cooling charts.
Spot hotspots, keep an optimal climate for IT and cut cooling energy without putting equipment at risk.
Track power at any moment, down to the individual server with per-outlet metering. History and dashboards to decide, not just watch.
From an aerial floor view down to devices in a single cabinet. Power paths, liquid loops and thermal maps in one twin.
Zones, granular role-based permissions, live feeds and reports so information stays in the right hands.
Interactive dashboards and reports to surface load, PUE and capacity trends — and act before the incident.
Synoptic view of the full chain. Impact search in one click: a port, a PDU, a rack, a tenant.
